items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

ctx.x: I came here in 1926. Yeah. Oh yeah. See, so he was down there.
Can you remember any other piano players in New Orleans? Steve Lewis?
I know Steve Lewis, yeah. I know Steve and my uncle Tapp. His name was, he could play piano. Who? Tapp Kato.
